## Summary
Describe which development standard is being added, changed, or removed and why.

---

## Review Checklist

This repository contains development standards. Every PR requires **2 approvals**.
Each reviewer ticks their own checkboxes below.

### Reviewer 1
- [ ] The proposed standard is clear, consistent, and aligned with the existing guidelines.
- [ ] The new or changed rules do not contradict any existing rules in this repository.
- [ ] The AI reviewer checklist (`ki-reviewer/review-checkliste.md`) has been updated or it has been confirmed that no update is required.
- [ ] Wording, formatting, and links have been checked.

### Reviewer 2
- [ ] The proposed standard is clear, consistent, and aligned with the existing guidelines.
- [ ] The new or changed rules do not contradict any existing rules in this repository.
- [ ] The AI reviewer checklist (`ki-reviewer/review-checkliste.md`) has been updated or it has been confirmed that no update is required.
- [ ] Wording, formatting, and links have been checked.
